description: This PHP source file defines the CsrfTokenManager class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the Symfony CSRF token management class and customizes it for OrangeHRM's architecture, specifically integrating it with the system's service container and token storage mechanisms.

classes.name: CsrfTokenManager
classes.description: A custom CSRF token manager extending Symfony's implementation, integrating OrangeHRM's service container and token storage, and providing a method to validate CSRF tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the token manager by retrieving token storage from the service container and passing it to the parent constructor along with a token generator.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given CSRF token (identified by $id and $value) is valid by creating a CsrfToken object and delegating to the parent 'isTokenValid' method.
